title: Police seal wedding venues in South Delhi’s Sainik Farms after HC order, families protest

ai.summary: Families in South Delhi's Sainik Farms protested after Delhi Police sealed wedding venues following a High Court order requiring illegal farms to be closed, citing safety concerns and lack of permits.

facts.claim: Police sealed several wedding venues in South Delhi’s Sainik Farms
facts.quote: The Delhi Police was however just following orders of the High Court, which had said that all farms operating illegally in the area, must be sealed by the civic authorities.

facts.claim: Families had pre-booked venues for weddings
facts.quote: On Monday and Tuesday, several families who had pre-booked these venues for their wedding function, took to the streets to protest.

The High Court order came on a petition filed by a local organisation. They raised the issue of legal marriage venues and banquet halls, and said that they were operating in the area, without proper fire safety clearances or statutory permissions from the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD).
Some senior police officials quoted by Hindustan Times said that by Tuesday afternoon, they had sealed 7 wedding venues.

ai.background_note: High Court ordered sealing of illegal wedding venues in South Delhi’s Sainik Farms due to safety concerns, leading to family protests over last-minute cancellations and financial strain.
